description: This Java source file contains a test step definition class for asset externalization features in the Fineract project. It includes multiple test scenarios, API interactions, and validation methods related to external asset owner transfers, journal entries, and business events.

classes.name: AssetExternalizationStepDef
classes.description: This class defines Cucumber step definitions for testing asset externalization features, including transfer requests, journal entries, events, and error handling within the Fineract project.

methods.name: createAssetExternalizationRequestByLoanIdUserGeneratedExtId
methods.description: Creates an asset externalization request for a loan ID using a user-generated transfer external ID.

methods.name: createAssetExternalizationRequestByLoanIdSystemGeneratedExtId
methods.description: Creates an asset externalization request for a loan ID with a system-generated transfer external ID.

methods.name: createAssetExternalizationRequestByLoanId
methods.description: Internal helper to create externalization request with specified transfer external ID.

methods.name: createAssetExternalizationRequestByLoanExternalIdUserGeneratedExtId
methods.description: Creates an externalization request for a loan external ID with a user-generated transfer external ID.

methods.name: createAssetExternalizationRequestByLoanExternalIdSystemGeneratedExtId
methods.description: Creates an externalization request for a loan external ID with a system-generated transfer external ID.

methods.name: checkAssetExternalizationResponse
methods.description: Verifies the externalization response contains the correct loan ID and transfer external ID.

methods.name: checkAssetExternalizationDetailsByLoanId
methods.description: Checks externalization details fetched by loan ID against expected data.

methods.name: checkAssetExternalizationDetailsByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Checks externalization details fetched by loan external ID against expected data.

methods.name: checkAssetExternalizationDetailsByTransferExternalId
methods.description: Checks externalization details fetched by transfer external ID against expected data.

methods.name: checkGeneratedTransferExternalId
methods.description: Validates the generated transfer external ID in the asset externalization details.

methods.name: buybackDateError
methods.description: Ensures an error is correctly returned when a buyback settlement date is earlier than allowed.

methods.name: transactionError
methods.description: Validates expected error responses for invalid asset externalization transactions.

methods.name: transactionErrorSalesOwnerNull
methods.description: Checks error response when sales transaction has null ownerExternalId.

methods.name: checkJournalEntriesTransaction
methods.description: Verifies journal entries for a transaction with the specified status.

methods.name: getLastTransferIdByStatus
methods.description: Returns the last transfer ID filtered by loan ID and status.

methods.name: getLastTransferId
methods.description: Returns the latest transfer ID for a given loan ID.

methods.name: getLastTransferByTransferType
methods.description: Returns the last transfer based on transfer type (buyback, sale, intermediarySale).

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventCheck
methods.description: Asserts that a loan ownership transfer business event has been created.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventWithStatusCheck
methods.description: Asserts that a loan ownership transfer business event with specific status and reason has been created.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventWithTypeCheck
methods.description: Verifies creation of a business event for a transfer with a specific type.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventCheckBasedOnIntermediarySale
methods.description: Verifies creation of business event based on intermediary sale status.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventIsNotRaised
methods.description: Ensures no business event was raised for the specified date.

methods.name: loanAccountSnapshotBusinessEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a loan account snapshot business event has been created.

methods.name: checkExternalAssetDetails
methods.description: Validates external asset transfer details against expected data.

methods.name: checkExternalAssetDetailsIgnoreTransferExternalId
methods.description: Validates external asset details ignoring transfer external ID, given optional filters.
